correctness.rationale: From the published equivalence, a crystal yields \(x+y-1\)^2=wxy\) with \(x=(a+1)/2\) and \(y=(b+1)/2\). This immediately gives \(\gcd(x,y)=1\). The published complete recurrence for positive solutions, reduced backwards modulo a hypothetical \(\gcd(a,b)\), forces \(u_1\) to equal both \(1\) and the inverse of \(2\), so \(\gcd(a,b)=1\). The support-two uniqueness corollary is then exact.
